title: Bytecode Inspector for Hot Paths
instructions: Implement the five audit helpers in `bytecode_tools.py` on top of `dis.get_instructions` and code-object attributes only: opcode counts, `LOAD_GLOBAL` names (unique, first-seen order), globals loaded inside loops (found from `JUMP_BACKWARD`), generator detection and closure variables. Anything without a code object must raise `TypeError`.

evidence.label: Lists LOAD_GLOBAL names including builtins, unique and in first-seen order
Finds the global names loaded inside a for-loop body
Hoisting globals into locals empties the in-loop list
Counts opcodes by name as positive integers
Detects generator functions and closure variable names
Ignores the bytecode of nested functions
Detects while loops and reports repeated globals once
Every helper raises TypeError for builtins and non-callables
